title: Prime Minister extends best wishes to Indian contingent for Asian Para Games 2026
subtitle: a
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, extended his best wishes to the Indian contingent as the Asian Para Games 2026 begin in Aichi-Nagoya. The Prime Minister said that India is immensely proud of its para-athletes, whose grit, dedication and indomitable spirit inspire 140 crore Indians. Shri Modi wished the athletes confidence and urged them to give their very best. The Prime Minister said in a X post; “As the Asian Para Games 2026 begin in Aichi-Nagoya, conveying my best wishes to the Indian contingent. India is immensely proud of our phenomenal para-athletes. Their grit, dedication and indomitable spirit inspire 140 crore Indians. May they compete with confidence and give their very best.”
